item.title: PM Skills Weekly — Issue 33
item.description:
Your weekly minute on doing professional work with AI — one skill to master, a few to try, and the numbers.
## 🌟 Skill of the week: Assumption Mapper Extract and risk-rate hidden assumptions in a product brief or PRD. **→ [Run it free](https://mohitagw15856.github.io/pm-claude-skills/?skill=assumption-mapper)** · `assumption-mapper` · ✅ 5/5
## 🔥 Fresh picks - **[Figma Design Critique — PM Perspective](https://mohitagw15856.github.io/pm-claude-skills/?skill=figma-design-critique-pm)** — Runs a PM-perspective design critique focused on product outcomes and user goals, not aesthetics. - **[Financial Due Diligence](https://mohitagw15856.github.io/pm-claude-skills/?skill=financial-due-diligence)** — Generate a financial due diligence checklist and analysis framework for any investment, acquisition, or partnership. - **[FOIA / Public-Records Request](https://mohitagw15856.github.io/pm-claude-skills/?skill=foia-request)** — Draft a public-records request (FOIA / FOI / state open-records) that's specific enough to get records and hard to deny.
